question: What Is The Best Advice You Have Ever Received?

answers.text: What should I ask the next 25 people?
It's not about what you know. It's about who you know. Connections
Don't work too hard.
Take it easy at your job.
I never received any advice
Work hard. Mind your business.
To not give up
Everybody can’t go

And why I say that is because a person like me. “Ya come on we can do it, everybody! Oh ya koom ba ya!” Even though I still feel that way and always will. Everybody can't go. Meaning you can't... ...keep forcing people... Let's just say that's trying to put the round peg into the square hole.

I guess just to keep yourself under control at all times. Stay calm. Stay confident in yourselff Don't don't just jump out and start coming up with ideas. You have to think first Engage your mind before you open your mouth.
Ignore people. Don't take anything to heart.
Don't look back. Just keep going.
Work hard. And in the end, you'll always have what you wanted in life. But work hard at it.
You want to keep on voting for Governor Hochul? Don't vote for her. She's not even doing nothing. She's not even doing nothing to support anybody else. For the people in the Bronx
Stay strong, keep going
If you put the work in, you'll find you'll find success at some day or sometime.
That's for me. That's my family. And then my grand-kid
embarrassments an underexplored emotion.
Just keep doing what you're doing and if you need help, ask for advice or anyone else.
Discipline the children and they have too much freedom, or too much on the phone.
That's why the governor of New York. She took it away when they put it in their locker That was a good decision.
Believe in yourself.
Hard work beats out talent 100% of the time.
When you set a goal, there's no timeframe on it, just make sure you achieve it
Keep your head up when facing adversity.
I feel like everything happens for a reason.

You know, you might have a very bad situation going on in your life, and you might be thinking, you know why me? Why is this happening? But, you know, it all works itself out, you know? I mean, it makes you the person that you are today.
Bad things need to happen in order for good things to happen.
Nobody ever gave me good advice.
Stay in your own lane.
Keep going. No matter how hard it gets
And mind your business.
Oh, I don’t know
To accept Jesus as my Savior and Lord
